title: Events disappeared for no reason
body:
Checked and it seems this is a recurring issue again and again at different periods of time. People who lose their calendar events for no issues and varying levels of ability to get their events back. I restarted the iPhone and checked for hidden calendars to no avail. I always had insufficient iCloud space so I only saved to iPhone which should be a very valid option to users, and woke up to my events disappearing. I was very sure my events existed yesterday.

This is ridiculous and I will switch to Google and eventually Android
